scope: Local runtime persistence, guards and performance audit; isolated synthetic data only
production_changes: Batch changed term_actuals exact-contract lookups at 500 IDs and unique-key upserts at 100 rows, updating quantity only
Persist server-owned exact-PP draft save proof atomically with canonical data and receipt; reject wrong-target confirmation and current-proof altered-payload replay
Calculate original canonical input hash once before transaction retries

regressions: Wrong visible PP receipt confirmation reproduced before fix and refused after fix
Forged client proof discarded; missing legacy proof remains unconfirmed without business writes
Same current proof replay succeeds once; altered payload same UUID returns 409 without duplicate receipt/revision
1000 actual details round-trip exactly; zero preserved; 998 existing IDs retained after row removal
Late-batch failure rolls back canonical term, details, workspace revision and receipt; contracts/balances unchanged

isolated_mariadb.confirmation_transport: Direct controller invocation; middleware separately covered in SQLite HTTP tests

browser_save.transport: Actual App, mocked API, external network blocked

compatibility.legacy_or_superseded_save_proof: No automatic confirmation after uncertain response; ordinary save remains supported; no historical resubmission needed

not_tested: Concurrent production throughput, all workspace-lock or contract-write bottlenecks
Real cron/Supervisor/Telegram delivery or bank transfer
Fresh physical rendering of every Word/PDF document or physical printing
deployment: Deploy source and built assets, verify assets; no new migration or env/key change. Restart only Area3 upload worker if running old source. Never reset data, seed live, purge queue or restart unrelated workers.
